english.title: Estate/interest holder in land fail to take steps required by notice relating to felling licence – Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed without reasonable excuse to take steps required by a notice given to **(..SPECIFY RECIPIENT..), a person having estate or interest in land at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) under section 24D(2) of the Forestry Act 1967, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT..), those steps not having been taken by a person who had been required to do so by a notice under section 24C(3) of the Act and who had ceased to have the estate or interest in the land by reference to which the notice was given before the time specified in that notice had expired
english.legislation: Contrary to section 24D(5) of the Forestry Act 1967.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 24D(6) of the Forestry Act 1967 provides that proceedings for an offence under this section may be instituted within six months from the first discovery of the offence by the person taking the proceedings, provided that no proceedings shall be instituted more than two years after the date of the offence.
